title: ONSure Multi-Agent Delegation Chain Check v1
description: FR-META-058 AI Nondeterminism and Multi-Agent Assurance / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS9.3 Delegation and SS9.6 Cyclic Delegation: 'Agent A가 Agent B에 일을 위임해도 B가 A보다 넓은 권한을 획득하지 않는다. delegation chain, purpose, TTL, subject scope를 보존한다... A->B->C->A delegation loop, 책임 떠넘기기, 무한 handoff를 탐지한다. final authority는 명시된 principal/contract에서만 온다.' This complements DelegationLedger (which enforces a single grant's delegator-must-hold-the-role invariant in isolation) by validating an entire multi-hop chain of edges at once: cycle_detected is computed by a real directed-graph traversal (visited + in-progress recursion-stack, standard cycle detection), not a caller-declared flag -- any agent reachable from itself following delegation edges is a cycle, regardless of how many other agents sit between. authority_expansion_detected is computed by checking, for every edge, that delegated_authority_scope is a real subset of that edge's own declared from_agent_authority_scope -- a delegate can never receive a capability its delegator did not declare holding.
